query: Which country has the largest population?
answer: India has the largest population of any country. The UN's World Population Prospects 2024, as reported by Statistics Times, puts it at about 1.48 billion people in 2026 [1]. India passed China, now second at roughly 1.4 billion, around 2022–2023. The UN dates the crossover to April 2023 [1][2]. These numbers are estimates: India's last full census was in 2011, and its new census only began in 2026, so exact figures differ from source to source.
